name: Tagarosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it among the 'protosuchians', a grade rather than a clade, so it is placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Tagarosuchus is a protosuchian-grade crocodyliform from the Early Cretaceous Ilek Formation of southern Siberia.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: A nearly complete skull found near Shestakovo, Kemerovo Oblast.
material: Skulls and other remains from the Ilek Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Alifanov et al. 1999

sources.text: Alifanov, V.R. 1999. A new Psittacosaurian complex of tetrapods from the Lower Cretaceous Shestakovo Locality (Southern Siberia). Doklady Earth Sciences 369: 1228–1230.
